# swarmops remote remove

Forget a git remote, and the mirror's refs of it; no changeset is removed.

```yaml
title: "swarmops remote remove"
description: "Forget a git remote, and the mirror's refs of it; no changeset is removed."
group: "remotes"

envelope_op: "remote_remove"

```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops remote remove [OPTIONS] <NAME>
```

## Required arguments

### `NAME`

Syntax: `<NAME>`.

The remote's name.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

## Return information

`result` is a `RemoteRemoveResp` (`swarmops schema RemoteRemoveResp` prints its JSON Schema).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | The remote's name. |
| `removed_refs` | `integer` | yes | How many of the mirror's refs of the remote were removed. |

Envelope `op`: `remote_remove`.

Exit codes:

- `0`: Success.
